fieldNotes.location: Geocoded point (ROOFTOP, moved 115m) lands accurately on a single tan industrial building in open country on the Range Regional Airport property south of US-169 near Hibbing MN. Confirmed via DTNA press releases as Detroit Diesel Remanufacturing -- the Hibbing reman plant whose 2024 expansion doubled the footprint to ~120,000 sq ft and added BEV battery/inverter remanufacturing. Address 3895 South Hughes Road.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. A single open driveway runs from US-169 down to the building's parking lots; Street View (captured 2025-08) shows no barrier arm, gate or guard booth, and no perimeter fence at the road -- the site is fully open.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere on site.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short, direct open driveway from the highway to the dock apron and lots; minimal stacking depth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 0-10: a single covered dock canopy with roughly 6-10 doors on the building's NW face; count approximate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 0-10: only a few trailers parked along the south edge; no dedicated drop yard.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot; the few trailers park ad hoc near the south parking lot.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single building. The red-roofed structure to the east is a separate airport-related building, not part of this plant.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Isolated site in open fields/farmland on airport property near Hibbing, a small northern-Minnesota town -> Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural, isolated open-country location on the Iron Range; cellular coverage may be weaker. Hibbing town and the regional airport are nearby so it is not extreme -> recorded true at medium confidence, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.confidence: High: the facility is positively identified and the small open layout reads clearly from satellite + recent (2025) Street View. Only the exact dock-door count and the inferred connectivity flag are uncertain.
